name: Liora
summary: Liora is topped with matte silver grey travertine marble, giving the piece a calm, stone sculptural elegance with natural depth. Below, the bottom panel and fiberglass base are finished in a sophisticated two tone grey palette, creating a layered, modern contrast. The combination delivers a grounded, architectural presence that feels refined without drifting into theatrics. Sliver grey travertine marble top(matte), bottom panel and fiberglass base paint two tone grey. 110x110x40
